name: l2cap_credit_queue_flush

ownership.argument: This is the credit-controlled drain the module expects: credits live at stock+14 (stock pointer is channel+4), the queued fragment list hangs off the stock, and sending is the same 0xC7FE4D0 transport call the send handler uses.

provenance.source: Loops while the channel stock still has credits (u16 at stock+14): dequeues one fragment with 0xC7EACD0, rewrites the fragment header words, sends it with 0xC7FE4D0 using cid = channel word +38 | (channel+116 << 16), decrements stock+14 and frees the node. Called by the LE Flow Control Credit handler 0xC803038 immediately after it adds the received credit to stock+14, and from the channel teardown path.
